title: Keep coding after your API budget runs out
excerpt: Keep coding after your API budget runs out. wcagent lets you use eligible browser-backed AI subscriptions and API models in one VS Code coding agent.
content_html:
API budget spent? Keep coding with an eligible browser-backed AI subscription. See how it works

One coding agent for browser subscriptions and APIs

Keep coding, even after
your API budget runs out.

Turn supported browser subscriptions you already pay for into a repository-aware coding agent in VS Code. Switch between available browser and API models without leaving your context, local tools, or workflow behind.

No model API key required for an eligible browser-backed connection · Local actions follow your approval settings

ChatGPTClaudeGeminiGrokDeepSeek

Current and planned browser connections · Availability rolls out by provider and account type · Provider limits and terms apply

One agent. More than one way to power it.

Move beyond API-only coding

Use an eligible browser subscription when API credits are gone, or choose an available API-backed model when it fits. wcagent keeps the coding workflow anchored in VS Code.

01 / CONNECT

Use the AI access you already have

Pair a supported browser subscription or select an available API-backed model. Both can power the same wcagent coding workflow.

See your connection options ↗

export async function retryRefund(id) {
  return withBackoff(async () => {
    const result = await capture(id);
    if (!result.ok) throw result;
    return result;
  }, { attempts: 3 });
}

KEEP CONTEXT

Stay inside the same repository.

wcagent keeps task-relevant files, instructions, diagnostics, Git state, and durable conversation history in the VS Code workflow.

KEEP TOOLS

Keep editing, testing, and reviewing.

What you keep

The model can change. The coding workflow doesn't.

wcagent separates the coding agent from the model connection. Your wcagent plan covers the VS Code workflow; you choose from the eligible model access available to your account.

01

Spend API budget deliberatelyUse API-backed models when they are worth the metered cost instead of making them your only route to AI coding.

02

Use browser subscription accessPair your account when a browser connector is available for that provider and account type.

03

Keep execution where the code livesCommands, edits, redaction, and workspace approvals remain authoritative inside desktop VS Code.

04

Finish with repository evidenceTests, builds, diffs, and diagnostics decide when the work is done. Model confidence does not.

The important distinction

Another connection, not a limit bypass.

When an API budget is exhausted, wcagent can let you select a separate eligible browser-backed connection. It never makes the exhausted API accept more requests, and the connection you switch to has its own provider limits.

Separate access

You bring the model account

wcagent supplies the agent workflow, not the underlying third-party model access.

Eligible connections

Use access you are allowed to use

Provider, account type, and connection method must permit use with wcagent.

Limits respected

Each connection keeps its limits

If a provider pauses or refuses a request, wcagent reports it. You can select another eligible connection; wcagent cannot override the first one.

Provider terms

No hidden workaround

wcagent does not defeat authentication, CAPTCHAs, safety systems, geographic restrictions, or technical access controls.

The API meter can stop. You don't have to.

Keep the coding session moving.

Install wcagent, pair eligible browser-backed AI access, and keep working in VS Code when an API-only workflow would send you home.
